# Portable format v1 fixture

`portable-v1.rsbackup` contains synthetic data only, generated by `scripts/test_cli.py` on Linux using the real storage/backup implementation. The test-only passphrase is `synthetic CI passphrase only`. The object `private synthetic name` contains `private-synthetic-content-42` repeated 6000 times. An age-wrapped random identity is intentionally included so this remains a stable, self-contained compatibility vector.

Do not regenerate this file casually: future readers must keep passing it. Dynamic CI fixtures are generated independently on Linux and Windows and restored on the other OS. No hosting credentials, real repository content or maintainer private keys are present.
